title: Measuring Structure in Graph Benchmark Datasets Using Graph Invariants
abstract: arXiv:2605.06462v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Progress in graph learning is hindered by benchmark practices that conflate the contributions of node features and graph structure, making it hard to tell whether a model actually learns from the graph, or whether it even needs to. We propose measuring this using graph invariants, i.e., permutation-invariant, task-agnostic structural descriptors. Our analysis on datasets substantiates three tacit assumptions in graph learning, namely that (i) a curated subset of invariants is more expressive than standard GNNs, (ii) benchmark datasets exhibit structural heterogeneity even when originating from the same domain, and (iii) simple models are often competitive with, and sometimes exceed, approaches based on transformers or message passing. We thus posit that graph invariants should become a standard tool for measuring graph learning task complexity and the relevance of graph structure.

translated_title: 使用图不变量度量图基准数据集中的结构
translated_abstract: 图学习的进展受到当前基准测试实践的阻碍，这些实践混淆了节点特征和图结构的贡献，使得人们难以判断模型是否真正从图结构中学习，甚至难以判断它是否需要这样做。我们提出使用图不变量来衡量这一点，即置换不变且与任务无关的结构描述符。我们对数据集的分析证实了图学习中三个隐含的假设，即：(i) 精选的不变量子集比标准GNN更具表达能力；(ii) 基准数据集即使源自同一领域也表现出结构异质性；(iii) 简单模型往往与基于transformer或消息传递的方法不相上下，有时甚至超越它们。因此，我们主张图不变量应成为衡量图学习任务复杂性和图结构相关性的标准工具。
tldr: 提出将图不变量作为衡量图学习任务复杂性和图结构相关性的标准工具，并实证证实了精选不变量子集更具表达能力、基准数据集存在结构异质性、以及简单模型常可媲美甚至超越transformer和消息传递等复杂方法三个隐含假设。
